reviews.text:
I only have praise for this clinic! My mother has been taking her animals to Dr. Valdemar for about 20 years, and this trust comes from the consistently excellent service, with great care and dedication.
I extend my affection and recognition to Dr. Ricardo. It's wonderful to see the love they have for their profession and the care they give to our pets.
Thank you for so many years of attention and commitment. I wholeheartedly recommend them! ❤️

It's absurdly disorganized. Dr. Valdemar is excellent, but unfortunately the service leaves much to be desired. They scheduled my cat's exam, and when I arrived, there was no appointment scheduled. There was a huge mess when responding to WhatsApp messages; each time they said something different, one day there was an appointment and the next day there wasn't. And when they finally scheduled it, I arrived with my cat fasting, and they simply told me there was no appointment and she wouldn't be seen! ZERO responsibility.

First time I took my dog ​​there and I loved it.
Everyone was attentive and careful, and the price is very affordable.
It will definitely be the place I'll go whenever I need to.
It only doesn't get a 5 because there's a receptionist on the morning shift who's very reactive. She doesn't even say good morning.
I've been taking my pet "son" there for years, I highly recommend it!
Excellent veterinarians. I recommend them.

The clinic is perfect, they are very attentive and all the professionals are amazing. If I have a choice, I'll only go to them. They've saved my pets' lives several times.
Simply perfect ❤️
My dog ​​had surgery there and received VIP treatment; she'll be home soon.
Great service, excellent professionals.

Dr. Waldemar is an excellent doctor and a very humane person!
Currently, my Juju is undergoing treatment with Dr. Angela, a wonderful, competent, and generous doctor... Her work has brought and continues to bring a better quality of life to my little daughter Juju, and I am deeply grateful!

Great clinic, great veterinarians!

I want to express my immense gratitude to this wonderful veterinary clinic, which has cared for my Mili with so much affection, dedication, and professionalism.

Dr. Ricardo has been extremely attentive and committed at every stage of the treatment, always seeking the best for her recovery. Dr. Angela, in rehabilitation, has done an absolutely incredible job with ozone therapy, demonstrating competence, care, and a true love for what she does.

In delicate moments, finding professionals like this makes all the difference. I can only thank them for all the support, attention, and dedication to my little one. I recommend them wholeheartedly! ❤️❤️
The service from both the staff and the veterinarians was excellent.

Excellent veterinarians and staff at a fair price.
Like everything good, it takes a little while, but it's well worth the wait.
good service
They were very attentive, kind, and quick in their service.

I have no words, excellent professionals, they saved my little dog and were even patient with me throughout the entire treatment while I cried for days in despair at the clinic…
I can't thank them enough, best clinic in the north zone ❤️
Dr. Natalye, Dr. Ricardo, Dr. Lucas and Dr. Natália

Terrible experience with Dr. Ricardo... for him, everything was an allergy... my pet had already undergone several exams, and for Dr. Ricardo, everything was an allergy, and there was no improvement in the pet's condition. He prescribed hypoallergenic food (very expensive)... changed the food bowls... and every day my pet wasted away more and more... according to Dr. Ricardo, it was normal because allergies take time to improve... until I went to another professional and discovered that the allergy Dr. Ricardo had diagnosed was actually megaesophagus... so much suffering for a pet because of a wrong diagnosis... I almost lost my pet to starvation.

Disappointed...after a procedure on my pet I received no guidance or recommendations from the professional who performed the procedure...in fact, the veterinarian didn't even show up to release the pet...total lack of respect for the pet...for the owner...lack of professionalism.... unfortunately I can't give zero stars...I do not recommend them.
Competent professionals
Excellent professionals.
We always take our baby there to treat her skin problems, we highly recommend them, the treatment is wonderful, very clean, and the professionals are top-notch.
Excellent professionals and very attentive, they even offer pet acupuncture.
All I needed was a parking lot.

My 17-year-old pet, Nega, has always received excellent care from Dr. Ricardo, Dr. Lucas, Dr. Fernando, Dr. Ângela, and today, for the second time, Dr. Natalia. She is an incredible human being and a wonderful professional. Gratitude to ALL, especially the assistants.
Great veterinarians

Unfortunately, I don't have a good review to give.
I was at the clinic yesterday, on the recommendation of a neighbor. Upon arrival, I was informed that my kitten would be the second animal to be seen by Dr. Valdemar.
I waited for more than 2 hours and he didn't call me. He kept walking back and forth, talking to everyone, going into the rooms and giving opinions about the animals that were being treated, but he didn't attend to those who were waiting for him. At a certain point, already tired of waiting, I told him that I had been waiting for almost 2 hours, but he made a gesture with his hand telling me to wait. My kitten was already stressed, panting and trembling with fear of the dogs that were waiting, and I was nervous with such disregard. Conclusion: I left and took her to another veterinarian. I found it a tremendous lack of attention and disrespect on the part of Dr. Valdemar. I do not recommend him.

I'd heard it recommended a long time ago, I went with my dog ​​at night and loved everything. The receptionist was very friendly and polite, giving me information before I was seen, and Dr. Paloma took great care of my Julie. Impeccable cleanliness and service! I highly recommend it.
They are extremely helpful and not opportunistic like many other clinics.
The service is always very good. I've been taking my pets there for over 20 years.
And the best clinic

First impressions are lasting, and my experience and impression were excellent. As a pet mom, I thought there were no more humane clinics and hospitals; I was terrified of entrusting my cat to "just anyone," but Dr. Fernando simply warmed my heart and comforted me with the care and affection he showed Thomas, his patience, professionalism, and explanation of what happened. I don't even have words to thank the entire team, from the reception to the doctor and his assistant. See you soon 💙
Excellent service, very good team!

I don't know exactly how long we've known the clinic. But I personally have been taking our pets there for over 5 years. And almost every attempt that wasn't at the Valdemar Pereira clinic seems to have been in vain. To all the professionals and partners who work at the clinic, thank you always!

Dr. Valdemar knows a lot!!

Good service and fair price.
I am very grateful for everything they did for my Doug, I highly recommend the clinic. Dedicated and qualified professionals, and they treat your pet with so much love and attention!!!

I went on the recommendation of a cat owner who has many felines; she suggested I take my cat to the veterinarian Ricardo. My cat has FeLV and contracted mycoplasmosis. She is currently undergoing treatment there.
A place that deserves a perfect score.
Best clinic ever! Dr. Ricardo and his team are always attentive and caring. Congratulations to everyone who works at the clinic!

Wonderful clinic, we went today on the recommendation of many friends from Vila Guilherme. Well-structured place, impeccable hygiene. And the veterinary orthopedist Dr. Mariane Martinez is an excellent professional, technically skilled, loving, and very knowledgeable in the field. She recommended the best treatment for my Golden Retriever, who is showing early signs of dysplasia. We felt welcomed and are certain that his treatment will be a success. Finally, we found professionals who love what they do and love animals. We are very happy, thank you Dr. for your love and dedication.

My review is twofold: the veterinarian is excellent—very attentive and committed to my pet's treatment. However, the reception service leaves much to be desired. On more than one occasion, I've received incomplete information, such as regarding weekend appointments. They said the doctor works on Saturdays, but didn't make it clear that it's not every Saturday. This kind of detail makes a difference and should be mentioned. As a result, I went to the clinic on a day he wasn't on call and ended up wasting time and money. I suggest more attention and clarity in the information provided by reception.

Attentive staff!

I needed the X-ray machine, but it wasn't working and they told me to come back on Saturday or Sunday! However, it wasn't working again.

Wonderful clinic!

I felt very comfortable leaving my kitten in the hands of the professionals there.

Excellent service, super transparent, and fair prices.

I recommend them.

It's a good clinic, but it's very difficult to get an appointment in less than 3 hours. It's the same as all the others. In an emergency, it's very bad because the animal suffers a lot, even with a scheduled appointment. Actually, nowadays it's very difficult to find a 5-star clinic. I'm still looking for a good veterinarian in the North Zone.
They care more about the animal than the profit, which is rare these days. They are very capable and honest. I was assisted by Lucas.

Service
Professional
Specialties
Top quality
Always very positive in the diagnosis and treatment of my pets.

I took my two children there this morning and the attention from the veterinarian Dr. Nalbert is truly outstanding….
Attentive and caring professional with our pets
Congratulations to the clinic!!!!
A welcoming place, congratulations to all the professionals, especially Dr. Nalbert who was a true angel taking care of my kitten and reassuring me.
Everything is great. From arrival to departure.
There's nothing to complain about at this place. The staff are great, the environment is clean, and it's in a very accessible location.
Excellent
Excellent service and great professionals. I highly recommend them.
Speechless! Excellent clinic! Dr. Fernando is an excellent doctor, very attentive!!!! We loved it!
A completely trustworthy clinic.
The best clinic in the region, excellent professionals.
Good professionals and good service. I recommend them.
Excellent, I recommend them. They are very attentive. It's a shame that the wait time is so long. But even so, I recommend them.
Excellent professionals treat pets with great care, affordable prices, and personalized service.
Excellent service
I like Dr. Fernando's service; he's patient, explains things very clearly, and answers all my questions!

Wonderful place. Committed, tireless professionals, prepared to care for our children. I thank each of the professionals who perform their duties with such dedication, love, and responsibility. Gratitude to Dr. Valdemar's Clinic.
This clinic is great!

Excellent professionals, they show great care and affection to our four-legged babies. I highly recommend them. We always take all our pets there, and the care that all the professionals have for them and for us is immense. I am so grateful to you all for everything you do. I won't mention names because I might forget someone, and that wouldn't be fair, but please feel embraced. Eternal gratitude ♡♡♡

It's a wonderful clinic, they treat all my pets...
Everyone is very attentive. I recommend them without hesitation!
Excellent clinic, great service, from the receptionists to the doctors 🙏🏼 everything clean, organized and good facilities! I recommend it! …
Excellent, fantastic service.
A trustworthy clinic to take your pets to; all the veterinarians who work there are excellent, and they are open every day, including Sundays and holidays.

I went on Saturday, January 11th.
It was empty.
Even so, we had to wait a long time to be served.
Excellent professionals
Excellent service, I highly recommend Dr. Valdemar Singular.
Very attentive and dedicated staff, plus an affordable price. I definitely recommend it.

Excellent clinic with highly qualified professionals.
Dr. Valdemar and Ricardo are spectacular.

I definitely recommend them.

My pets have been going to the clinic for years and I have no complaints. We've been seen by doctors Ricardo, Valdemar, Lucas, Fernando, Paloma, Marianne, and Ângela, and they've all been incredible to us. The medical staff is excellent and extremely qualified. The cleaning staff are always very friendly, and the receptionists (Laís, Pamella, and Alexandre) are always very kind to us. The doctors who perform the ultrasound and echocardiograms are also very kind. Just gratitude for all the care!
Excellent service!!! I recommend them, a qualified team!! Good veterinarians.

Nothing to complain about, above average, but I don't understand the resistance to scheduling appointments when there are sometimes two receptionists. Waiting 2 hours for a follow-up appointment after surgery is exhausting for any animal.
Dr. Ricardo is an excellent professional.
A leading veterinary clinic in the northern region, with excellent service.
